reason: A motorcycle may not be used to tow another vehicle.
A Code 1 learner's licence prohibits passengers, and a passenger must be seated on a securely fastened seat.
Motorcycles, motor tricycles, and trailers need only a rear number plate.
A rider's feet must rest on the front foot rests, seated astride the saddle, with at least one hand on the handlebars at all times.
All wheels of the motorcycle must stay in contact with the road surface at all times.
The rule mentions handlebar height must meet prescribed measurements, but does not specify the 500mm value.
A motorcycle's load may not project more than 900mm behind the rear axle.
A motorcycle's load may not project more than 600mm in front of the front axle.
No rule directly supports the factors affecting stopping distance.
Towing at over 30 km/h with a rope or chain is not allowed, and a towed vehicle may only carry passengers at over 30 km/h if it is a semi-trailer.
The tow-rope, chain, or tow-bar between two vehicles may not exceed 3.5 metres in length.
Lighting rules don't apply to a vehicle parked off the roadway, in a demarcated parking place, or within 12 metres of a lit street lamp.
